svg.title: Undoing an agent action
svg.desc: 1. The user taps Undo on the Agent AI page, or the agent calls undo_recent_action with latest set to true. 2. BYM loads the stored action with the state before and after. 3. If any affected record was changed again since, the undo is refused. 4. Otherwise the same delete and restore cascade as the app's own delete button runs and balances are recomputed. 5. The action is marked as undone and shown struck through in the activity list.
svg.text: The user taps Undo on the
Agent AI page, or the agent
with the state before and after.
The action is marked as undone
